github.name: excalidraw
github.description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams

readme.excerpt: Excalidraw Editor · Documentation · npm · Blog · Excalidraw+ An open source virtual whiteboard with a hand-drawn style, collaborative and end-to-end encrypted. Sketch diagrams, wireframes or whatever you like at excalidraw.com, or embed the editor in your own app with the `@excalidraw/excalidraw` React component. Features The Excalidraw editor (npm package) supports: - 💯 Free and open source : MIT licensed. - 🎨 Infinite canvas : zoom and pan without running out of room, with a minimap to find your way around. - ✍️ Hand-drawn style : shapes, arrows and text that look sketched, with a choice of fonts, in light or dark mode. - ⚒️ Wide range of tools : rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, free-draw, text, sticky notes, frames, web embeds, laser pointer, eraser and more. - ➡️ Arrows that follow your shapes : arrow binding, labeled arrows and elbow arrows. - 🔀 Flowcharts from the keyboard : Ctrl/Cmd+arrow keys add the next node, Alt+arrow keys move between nodes. - 🧜 Mermaid diagrams : paste a Mermaid definition and get shapes you can keep editing, with Mermaid to Excalidraw. - 📊 Charts : paste spreadsheet data and get a bar, line or radar chart. - 📷 Images and shape libraries : drop in images and crop them, and reuse shapes from public libraries or your own. - 🔍 Command palette and search : run any action, or find text in the scene, from the keyboard. - 🖼️ Export to PNG
